title: Program Part of the Appraisal Order Final Inspection Charge
content:
The program part of the Appraisal Order final inspection charge reads the loan program of the Mortgage Loan File the order supports: the Larkspur FHA 30-Year Fixed adds 50 dollars, the Larkspur VA 30-Year Fixed adds 40 dollars, and every other program adds nothing. The program part is added to the final inspection charge.

| Loan program on the Mortgage Loan File | Program part (USD) |
|---|---|
| Larkspur FHA 30-Year Fixed | 50.00 |
| Larkspur VA 30-Year Fixed | 40.00 |
| Larkspur HomeReady 30-Year Fixed | 0.00 |
| Larkspur Conventional 30-Year Fixed | 0.00 |
| Larkspur Conventional 15-Year Fixed | 0.00 |
| Larkspur High-Balance Conforming 30-Year Fixed | 0.00 |
| Larkspur Jumbo 30-Year Fixed | 0.00 |

*Point of judgement:* the program part follows the loan program on the file, not the report type; a Larkspur VA 30-Year Fixed file adds 40.00 whether its order is a Larkspur Single-Family Appraisal (Form 1004) or a Larkspur Condominium Appraisal (Form 1073).
